findings.description: Shrinkage rate uses total movement value instead of opening inventory value as denominator, potentially skewing rates during high-activity periods
findings.suggested_fix: Consider using opening inventory value or average inventory value as denominator for more accurate shrinkage rate calculation

findings.description: Expiry alerts may have overlap edge case where batches expiring exactly today could trigger both expiring and expired alerts
findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit time boundaries to ensure expiring and expired alerts are mutually exclusive
